name: linux_arm
title: Linux ARM
description: Linux ARM is a Unix-like and mostly POSIX-compliant computer operating system (OS) assembled under the model of free and open-source software development and distribution. Using host OS (Mac OS X, Linux ARM) you can build native application for Linux ARM platform.

libgpiod.description: libgpiod is the official Linux kernel GPIO library using the character device interface (/dev/gpiochip*). Works across all Linux ARM SBCs (Raspberry Pi, Orange Pi, Rock Pi, etc.) with kernel-enforced GPIO exclusivity
libgpiod.title: libgpiod

lgpio.description: lgpio is a modern C library for Linux GPIO access, supporting all Raspberry Pi models including Pi 5 with the RP1 I/O controller
lgpio.title: lgpio

wiringpi.description: WiringPi is a GPIO access library written in C for the BCM2835+ used in the Raspberry Pi. Now maintained by GC2 (Grazer Computer Club) with Raspberry Pi 5 support (GCLK function not supported on Pi 5)
wiringpi.title: WiringPi (GC2 Fork)

pigpio.description: pigpio is a feature-rich C library for Raspberry Pi GPIO control with microsecond timing, PWM, and servo support (Pi 1-4, not Pi 5 compatible)
pigpio.title: pigpio

arduino-bridge.description: arduino-bridge provides a C++ MsgPack-RPC client library for the Arduino Uno Q. MCU firmware registers arbitrary methods via Bridge.provide(name, cb); Linux C++ calls them via Bridge.call(name, params) over the arduino-router Unix socket. Requires arduino-router daemon (pre-installed on Uno Q Debian image).
arduino-bridge.title: arduino-bridge (Arduino Uno Q)

upload_run_after.description: Execute uploaded program immediately after successful upload

upload_run_command.description: Custom command to run the uploaded program (overrides default execution). WARNING: this value is executed as an arbitrary shell command on the remote target.

upload_run_timeout.description: Timeout for remote program execution in seconds (default: 300)

upload_user.description: Default SSH username for uploads (default: pi)

upload_ssh_key.description: Path to SSH private key for authentication

upload_flags.description: Additional flags passed to the upload tool (scp/rsync/ssh)

upload_strict_host_check.description: Enable SSH strict host key checking for uploads (default: false)

test_transport.description: Test upload transport: ssh or manual (default: ssh)

test_port.description: SSH connection string for test execution (format: user@host:/path)

test_ssh_port.description: SSH port used for test upload and execution (default: 22)

test_username.description: SSH username for test upload and execution (default: pi)

test_path.description: Remote path where the test binary is uploaded (default: /tmp/test_program)

test_upload_timeout.description: Timeout for test binary upload in seconds (default: 300)

test_timeout.description: Timeout for remote test execution in seconds (default: 600)

test_ssh_key.description: Path to SSH private key for test upload and execution

test_strict_host_check.description: Enable SSH strict host key checking for test operations (default: false)

debug_strict_host_check.description: Enable SSH strict host key checking for GDB debug sessions (default: false)
